zh-CN.title: 探索者外观 · 小哀表情
items: 小哀表情放大为文字的三倍，保持文字上边距和行高不变
为表情预留横向与外部空间，避免遮挡相邻消息和引用文字

en.title: Explorer styles · Ai expressions
items: Ai expressions are three times the text size while preserving text top padding and line height
Inline and external spacing keeps portraits clear of neighboring messages and quoted text
